# Load libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
```


# Read in data

```{r set.up.data}
#abx_recency_enterotypes.csv

enterotypes = read.csv('../data/abx_recency_enterotypes.csv',
                  colClasses = c(sample = "character"))

abx_covar = read.csv('../data/abx_covariates_with_statins_a1c_all_covars.csv',
                  colClasses = c(public_client_id = "character"))

names(enterotypes)[1] <- "public_client_id"

# Merge metadata w/ labs onto enterotypes
abx_entero_merged <- merge(enterotypes, abx_covar,
                         by = "public_client_id")

# Factor abx recency
abx_entero_merged$abx_recency <- factor(abx_entero_merged$abx_recency,
                                        levels=c("none", "twelve", "three"))
```

Let's set up creation of our plots

```{r create.med.context}
# This will paste the text along with the variable condition
# None will be -
# Users will be +
abx_entero_merged$med_context <- paste0(
  "abx ", ifelse(abx_entero_merged$abx_recency == "none", "-", "+"), " / ",
  "statin ", ifelse(abx_entero_merged$statin_binary == "Yes", "+", "-")
)

# Create a new df to look at instances for each med context
plot_data <- dplyr::count(
  abx_entero_merged,      # In this df
  med_context,                # Within each group
  enterotype,                 # Count the enterotypes
  name = "enterotype_count")

# Next we should count the med contexts to calculate proportions
med_context_count <- dplyr::count(
  abx_entero_merged,            # In df
  med_context,                      # count med_context
  name = "med_context_count")

# Now left join on plot data to propagate the med_context sums
plot_data <- dplyr::left_join(
  plot_data,                      
  med_context_count,
  by = "med_context"
)

# Now let's calculate the percentage of each enterotype within context
plot_data <- group_by(plot_data, med_context)
plot_data <- mutate(
  plot_data,                          # In this df
  total_N = enterotype_count,         # New col for total N
  percentage = (enterotype_count      # Calculate percentable
                / med_context_count),
  x_label_with_N = paste0(            # Make x-axis label
    med_context, "\n(N = ",
    enterotype_count, ")")
)

plot_data <- ungroup(plot_data)
```

```{r color.scheme}
color_scheme=c(
  "Prev"="yellowgreen",
  "Rum"="#d2b48cff",
  "Bac1"="#e6e6faff",
  "Bac2"="#a288aaff"
)
```


```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=5}
p <- ggplot(abx_entero_merged, aes(x = abx_recency, fill = enterotype)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_scheme) + 
  geom_text(stat = "count",
            aes(label = scales::percent(
              after_stat(count / tapply(count, x, sum)[x]),
              accuracy = 1
              )),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5)
  ) +

  # Simplest way to add (N=) to X-axis: calculate counts dynamically right here
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "\n(N = ", table(abx_entero_merged$abx_recency)[x], ")")
  ) +
  theme(text=element_text(size=14)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  labs(y = "Enterotype Distribution (%)", x = "Medication Use")
```

Look at Bac2 enchrichment in the cohort:

```{r bac2.logit}
abx_entero_merged$bac2 <- ifelse(abx_entero_merged$enterotype == "Bac2",
                                     1,  # Bac2
                                     0)  # All other enterotypes

abx_entero_merged$bac2 <- factor(abx_entero_merged$bac2)

bac2_logit_abx_recency <- glm(bac2 ~ age + sex + centered_BMI + vendor_dashboard + 
                    PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + centered_eGFR +
                     meds_cholesterol + meds_blood_sugar + abx_recency,
                    family = binomial(), data = abx_entero_merged)

summary(bac2_logit_abx_recency)
```

Also test a depletion in the Rum enterotype.

```{r rum.logit}
abx_entero_merged$rum <- ifelse(abx_entero_merged$enterotype == "Rum",
                                     1,  # Rum
                                     0)  # All other enterotypes

abx_entero_merged$rum <- factor(abx_entero_merged$rum)

rum_logit_abx_recency <- glm(rum ~ age + sex + centered_BMI + vendor_dashboard + 
                    PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + centered_eGFR +
                     meds_cholesterol + meds_blood_sugar + abx_recency,
                    family = binomial(), data = abx_entero_merged)

summary(rum_logit_abx_recency)
```


```{r create.table.fder}
results <- bind_rows(
  tidy(bac2_logit_abx_recency) %>% mutate(Outcome = "bac2"),
  tidy(rum_logit_abx_recency) %>% mutate(Outcome = "rum")
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(estimate),
    CI_lower = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
    CI_upper = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error)
  )

# Apply FDR separately for each contrast
results <- results %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(FDR_p = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# Format the results table
results_table <- results %>%
  transmute(
    Contrast = term,
    Outcome,
    Coef = estimate,
    SE = std.error,
    Z = statistic,
    OR,
    `95% CI` = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", CI_lower, CI_upper),
    `Raw p` = p.value,
    `FDR-adjusted p` = FDR_p
  )

table_abx_recencythree <- results_table %>%
  filter(Contrast == "abx_recencythree")

table_abx_recencytwelve <- results_table %>%
  filter(Contrast == "abx_recencytwelve")
```
